\[
\sigma^2(x,y) = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{w \in W_{xy}} w^2 - \Bigl(\frac{1}{n} \sum_{w \in W_{xy}} w\Bigr)^2
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(W_{xy}\): The window around (x, y)
- \(n\): Number of values in the window

The population variance of the n values in the window W_xy: the mean of the squares minus the square of the mean. It is 0 in flat areas and large on edges and texture. The unit is levels squared.
